title: Spiced Studio Spark

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 minutes while sketching or brainstorming.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; avoid fabrics.

why_it_works: Bright orange lifts the mood while rosemary and coriander add a warm, peppery spark that feels focused and lively without being heavy.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
